# Filter for Crossfit_Hanna and TransactPlus in 2023
cf_hanna = payments[(payments['merchant'] == 'Crossfit_Hanna') & 
                     (payments['card_scheme'] == 'TransactPlus') & 
                     (payments['year'] == 2023)].copy()

# Convert day_of_year to month using vectorized operation
cf_hanna['month'] = cf_hanna['day_of_year'].apply(lambda x: day_of_year_to_month(x, 2023))

print(f"Unique months in Crossfit_Hanna TransactPlus data: {sorted(cf_hanna['month'].unique())}")

# Filter for November (11) and December (12)
cf_hanna_filtered = cf_hanna[cf_hanna['month'].isin([11, 12])].copy()

print(f"Transactions in Nov-Dec 2023: {len(cf_hanna_filtered)}")
print(f"Unique acquirer_countries: {sorted(cf_hanna_filtered['acquirer_country'].unique())}")

# Group by acquirer_country and calculate average transaction value
result = cf_hanna_filtered.groupby('acquirer_country')['eur_amount'].mean().round(2).sort_values()

print("\nAverage transaction value by acquirer_country (sorted ascending):")
print(result)

# Format as required
result_list = [f"{country}: {amount}" for country, amount in result.items()]
print("\nFormatted result:")
